season_trajectories.note: Shared Gaussian team-strength copula; SD 0.35 is an assumption, not fitted. Preserves input game marginals. Completed results fixed; wins exclude ties. No playoffs or arbitrary win caps.

note: Revised-source retrospective evaluation; not prospective. Three models: semi-Markov, existing Ridge paired-residual and Poisson recipes refitted chronologically. OT stopping rules are tested; possession timing, conversions and field transitions remain approximations. No production promotion.

comparison_evidence.note: Decisive-game calibration excludes ties. Paired season-week bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, seed 42. Few weeks and multiple comparisons limit inference; intervals are descriptive, not promotion evidence.
